```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A central reason why the 20th century came to be called the American Century was the ability of individuals to invent and create in a land of free markets.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Entrepreneurs, independent contractors, and small business men and women drive improvement and force long-established institutions to adapt or fade away.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Entrepreneurs, independent contractors, and small business men and women create most new jobs and form the commercial network that holds communities together.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The enterprise of entrepreneurs, independent contractors, and small business men and women is the lifeblood of the economy, but it is weakening.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More businesses are closing in the country than are starting.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Older firms are an increasing proportion of companies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Productivity growth has slowed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"This is not the way to jumpstart a new era of growth.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Consideration should be given to the effect of capital gains rates on the availability of venture capital.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Consideration should be given to the positive impact of expensing on start-up firms.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
